d: Sri Lanka A produced a dominant batting performance to defeat India A by 8 wickets in the first semi-final of the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026. After India A posted an impressive 317/8, Sri Lanka A chased down the target comfortably, powered by outstanding centuries from Lasith Croospulle and Sineth Jayawardena, while Nishan Madushka remained unbeaten on 58. The convincing victory secured Sri Lanka A's place in the tournament final.
